verses.translation: The Inevitable Hour
What is the Inevitable Hour
And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is
˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster
As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast

verses.arabicText: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ammā ʿādun fa-uh'likū birīḥin ṣarṣarin ʿātiyat
verses.translation: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind

verses.arabicText: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
verses.transliteration: Sakharahā ʿalayhim sabʿa layāliw-wathamāniyata ayyāmin ḥusūman fatarā l-qawma fīhā ṣarʿā ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin khāwiyat
verses.translation: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
Do you see any of them left alive

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.transliteration: Wajāa fir'ʿawnu waman qablahu wal-mu'tafikātu bil-khāṭi-at
verses.translation: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin

verses.arabicText: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.translation: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: Innā lammā ṭaghā l-māu ḥamalnākum fī l-jāriyat
verses.translation: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺

verses.arabicText: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
verses.translation: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.translation: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast

verses.arabicText: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
verses.translation: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow
on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass
The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Wal-malaku ʿalā arjāihā wayaḥmilu ʿarsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-idhin thamāniyat
verses.translation: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Yawma-idhin tuʿ'raḍūna lā takhfā minkum khāfiyat
verses.translation: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden

verses.arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi fayaqūlu hāumu iq'raū kitābiyah
verses.translation: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record
I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”
They will be in a life of bliss
in an elevated Garden
whose fruit will hang within reach

verses.arabicText: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: Kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā aslaftum fī l-ayāmi l-khāliyat
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”

verses.arabicText: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu bishimālihi fayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ūta kitābiyah
verses.translation: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record
nor known anything of my reckoning
I wish death was the end
My wealth has not benefited me
My authority has been stripped from me.”
˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them
then burn them in Hell

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.transliteration: Thumma fī sil'silatin dharʿuhā sabʿūna dhirāʿan fa-us'lukūh
verses.translation: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long

verses.arabicText: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Innahu kāna lā yu'minu bil-lahi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest
nor encouraged the feeding of the poor
So this Day they will have no close friend here
nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus
which none will eat except the evildoers.”
Now, I do swear by whatever you see
and whatever you cannot see
Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger

verses.arabicText: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā huwa biqawli shāʿirin qalīlam-mā tu'minūn
verses.translation: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith

verses.arabicText: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful
˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name
We would have certainly seized him by his right hand
then severed his aorta

verses.arabicText: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā minkum min aḥadin ʿanhu ḥājizīn
verses.translation: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺
Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺
And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial
and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers
And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth
So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
